content: Metronidazole is contraindicated in patients who have a known history of hypersensitivity to metronidazole or other nitroimidazole derivatives. FLAGYL 375 capsules should not be used in patients with trichomoniasis during the first trimester of pregnancy. The use of oral metronidazole has been associated with psychotic reactions in alcoholic patients who are concurrently using disulfiram. Metronidazole should not be administered to patients who have taken disulfiram within the past two weeks. Oral metronidazole can cause a disulfiram-like reaction when consumed with alcohol. This reaction may include symptoms such as abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, headaches, and flushing. Patients should avoid consuming alcohol or products containing propylene glycol during treatment with metronidazole and for at least three days after completing therapy.
